page.layout: One printed page: title page inside a decorative woodcut border. Top: title block in capitals and italics, with a woodcut ornament below it. Lower block: epigraph by Augustine, then the imprint.

l.i: GRYNAEO, quum is, Aprilis die XV Anno Christianæ

main_text.l: Nullus reprehensor formidandus est amatori veri-
tatis: etenim, aut inimicus reprehensurus est,
aut amicus: si inimicus insultat, ferendus est:
amicus autem, si errat, docendus: si docet, au-
Si de veritate sumitur scandalum, vtilius permitti-
tur nasci scandalum, quàm veritas relinquatur.

page.notes: Woodcut ornaments only: a decorative border around the page and a fleur-like ornament between the title and the epigraph; no text in them. Handwriting in the top left ("4° Diss. 3234 (17)") and the top centre ("3") is a library shelf mark and is left out. Orthography: the printer's capital I for consonant J in "Iohanne" and "Iacobo" is given as J per the rule on i/j. Italic extent in the title block is read from the scan and may be slightly off at the line ends.
